layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a gray header band; slide number '46' in a yellow circle at top-right. Below, two side-by-side scatter-plot panels, each with red L-shaped axes and a red caption underneath. Left panel shows three clusters of points; right panel shows the same data with a highlighted yellow region around the green cluster, a red outlier point, and thin red lines connecting the outlier to other points. A small green-bordered label box 'Outlier Sample' sits above the right panel with a pointer line to the red point. Entire slide framed by a thin red border.

regions.content: Scatter plot with red axes showing three clusters: green points (left), cyan points (upper right), tan/beige points (bottom center); caption 'Data of Three Classes' below

layout.hierarchy: Title largest and boldest (red + blue). Panel captions next in bold dark red. Diagrams dominate the body area. Small label box and slide number are minor elements.

visual_elements.description: Left scatter plot: red L-shaped axes (vertical up arrow, horizontal right arrow), no ticks or axis labels. Three clusters of circular points: ~10 green points on the left/middle, ~9 cyan points upper-right, ~6 tan/beige points bottom-center. Caption below: 'Data of Three Classes'.

Right scatter plot: same red axes and same three clusters. A translucent yellow irregular blob highlights the green cluster plus a circled green point at its top-right edge. A solid red point (the outlier) sits just right of that circled green point. Thin light-red lines radiate from the red outlier point to the cyan points (upper right) and tan points (bottom). Small red arrows/markers appear on several points. A small green '+' marker appears inside the yellow region. Caption below: 'Nearest Neighbor is the Green class'.
Small rectangular label box with light green fill and green border containing two lines of text: 'Outlier' / 'Sample'; a thin gray pointer line connects it to the red outlier point.
Yellow circle with dark border containing slide number '46' in dark text.

recreation_brief: 1. White background slide with a thin dark-red (#B22222) rectangular border inset slightly from edges. 2. Add a light gray (#E8E8E8) header band across the top (~15% height). 3. In the header, place bold sans-serif title: 'Nearest Neighbors ' in dark red (#B22222) followed by '(NN) Outlier Problem' in blue (#0000CC), centered. 4. Top-right of header: yellow (#FFF9C4) circle with dark outline containing '46'. 5. Left panel (~10-48% width): draw red L-shaped axes (vertical line with up arrow, horizontal line with right arrow). Scatter ~10 green (#7CFC00) circles in a left/middle cluster, ~9 cyan (#00E5E5) circles upper-right, ~6 tan (#F5DEB3) circles bottom-center. 6. Below left panel, bold dark-red caption: 'Data of Three Classes'. 7. Right panel (~52-92% width): duplicate the same axes and points. Add a translucent yellow (#FFFF99) irregular polygon blob enclosing the green cluster. Circle the top-right green point with a yellow ring. Place a solid red (#FF0000) point just to its right (the outlier). Draw thin light-red lines from the red point to each cyan point and each tan point. Add small red arrow markers on several points and a small green '+' inside the yellow blob. 8. Above the right panel, add a small light-green (#E8F5E9) box with green border containing 'Outlier' on line 1 and 'Sample' on line 2, with a thin gray leader line to the red point. 9. Below right panel, bold dark-red caption: 'Nearest Neighbor is the Green class'.
